payload.summary: Clozapine canary answers were discarded because table extraction interleaved the columns; extractor fixed, corpus re-index outstanding
payload.detail: RESOLVED AS TO CAUSE 2026-09-16, by a live guest search of the production public corpus (read-only, user-authorised). CAUSE: page text came from page.get_text('text', sort=True), which orders text LINES by (y, x). A table whose cells wrap over several lines is therefore read straight ACROSS the columns. The served chunk from Clozapine Therapy - Initiation, Continuation and Ceasing Policy and Procedure (RKPG).pdf p16 reads 'Neutropenia Requires medical review. Stop clozapine. Contact WBC < 1.5 x 10 9/L. Flu-like symptoms such 3.2% haematologist ...', binding the withhold threshold to the word 'Contact' rather than to 'Neutropenia'. Answer verification correctly refused to state a clozapine threshold from that text. Nothing was wrong with retrieval, ranking, chunk splitting or any guard. EVIDENCE: the live search returned 12 chunks across 7 WA clozapine guidelines (FSH, CAMHS, RKPG, NMHS x2, AKG, FSH GP Shared Care), so the documents are retrievable and admitted; exactly one of the 12 bound a blood-count threshold to a stop instruction, and that one was the scrambled chunk. CORRECTION TO THIS ROW'S OWN EARLIER REPORTING: an interim analysis in the same session stated 'zero of twelve chunks bind a figure to an action'. That was WRONG. The detector used only ANC and neutrophil, while these WA guidelines say WBC, neutropenia and agranulocytosis. The correct count is one of twelve. The wrong count briefly supported a corpus-gap reading; it is recorded here so the number is not re-quoted. FOURTH DISPROVED THEORY, added to the two already in this row: 'the expected document is scoped uploaded_local and is unretrievable by design' is FALSE - retrieval returned these documents to an unauthenticated caller. The alias tables also already absorb the corpus renames, so a stale expectedFiles entry is not the cause either. FIXED IN CODE: extract_pdf_assets.table_aware_page_text substitutes the cell-by-cell rendering find_tables() already computes for detected grid regions, leaving surrounding prose in reading order, with a retention guard that keeps the raw text if detection would swallow the page and an ignore rule for heuristic non-grid candidates. Reproduced on a synthetic three-column table with wrapped cells, mutation-tested (removing the fix reproduces the exact production string), covered by worker/python/test_extract_pdf_assets_table_reading_order.py (5 tests) with the full worker suite green at 27 passed. STILL OUTSTANDING AND OPERATOR-ONLY: the fix only applies to documents ingested after it ships, so every already-indexed chunk keeps the scrambled wording until re-ingested. Step 6 of scripts/operator-clozapine-retrieval-diagnosis.sql lists the affected chunks and collapses them into a per-document re-index worklist, using two fingerprints validated against the real production text. The eval cases stay red until that re-index runs. DO NOT relax the cases, the verification predicate or adjacentLabelledNumericBandConflicts - the refusal is correct behaviour on corrupted evidence.
